cell.grouping_evidence: 16S1P review assumption, not an asserted e-bike pack configuration
cell.capacity_role: C-rate reference derived from 0.2C = 970 mA; metadata only, not a separate guaranteed capacity; fixed-voltage short-time surrogate, no SOC integration

unavailable: pause-command to physical FET turn-off latency

tdk.limits: Simple constant model. No nonlinear charge / voltage-bias curve fitted.

qucs_switch.purpose: Native voltage-controlled SPST connectivity and SPICE export; no source code copied.

lg_m50.title: LG Chem INR21700 M50 18.2Wh product specification (manufacturer document hosted by Conrad)
lg_m50.limits: Tentative specification, not an identified production-lot certificate. No fitted R0/polarization split, relaxation capacitance or cell inductance. This is M50, not M50LT; mirror filename does not match the document model.

cell_voltage.evidence: LG M50 nominal voltage; selected review operating point, not a measured OCV/SOC curve

cell_r.evidence: Assumed partition: 20 mOhm R_cell + 10 mOhm R_relax = LG M50 nominal 30 mOhm DC resistance
cell_r.conditions: LG specifies 30 +/- 6 mOhm at 50% SOC, 0.5C for 30 s, 25 +/- 2 C; AC impedance <=25 mOhm at 1 kHz after standard charge. The 20/10 split is not manufacturer-fitted; nominal voltage is not a calibrated 50%-SOC OCV.

cell_relax_r.conditions: Unfitted placeholder; LG M50 specification supplies no polarization RC parameters. The 20/10 mOhm resistance split and 10 ms relaxation time are assumptions, not manufacturer calibration.

cell_relax_c.conditions: Unfitted placeholder; LG M50 specification supplies no polarization RC parameters. The 20/10 mOhm resistance split and 10 ms relaxation time are assumptions, not manufacturer calibration.

fuse_r.conditions: Nominal cold resistance for 0.500 A; uncertainty range is assumed, not a rated tolerance. Intact fuse only.

sense_r.conditions: TNPW0603100RBEEA 0.1%; temperature coefficient below is assumed pending verification.

cap_c.conditions: CGA3E3X7R1E474K080AE; printed tolerance only, not DC-bias allowance.

cap_esr.conditions: Scalar constant-ESR approximation; frequency/temperature dependence is not calibrated.

vc_input_current.conditions: Typical 8 uA with main ADC on. Return to AVSS is an explicit surrogate assumption; retained during balancing OFF.

switch_ron.conditions: 2.5 ohm illustrative nominal; TI min 1.45/max 4.6 ohm at VCn >2.8 V, -40<TA<125 C. Exact typical value not tabulated.

bat_current.conditions: BAT active typical; remaining rail load is separate.

board_current.conditions: Top-tap to local AVSS equivalent; no regulator internals and no claim of actual board consumption.

cb_package_l.conditions: Per CB pin, shared by adjacent switches; not a TI package specification.

via_l.conditions: Per via in the measured capacitor-bank to IC route. Not a field extraction.

switch_cds.conditions: Constant capacitance across internal switch nodes. TI Coss/Qoss versus bias not established; no guaranteed physical bound.

drawing.capacitance_model: Nominal TDK simple model, 470 nF; no automatic DC-bias multiplier applied
drawing.switch_control: All V_enable sources are static 0 V. Electrical SPST symbols are abstract internal CBFETs, not fitted relays. No timed switch events.
drawing.control_voltage_role: 0/1 V logic surrogate, not physical gate voltage or a TI gate-drive specification

measurement_scope.target: External VC1..VC16 and CB capacitor-bank voltages
measurement_scope.threshold_role: Investigation target, not a product accuracy requirement
